all_findings.issue: AC3 FAIL: applyBridge cross-slot move semantics incomplete. The fix adds removal of option from originSlotId.options[] but the preceding cross-meal copy block (lines 2927-2945) adds the same option to targetSlotId.options[]. mealsGroup iterates all meal slots and deduplicates by option_id — the option survives in sidebar via targetSlotId.options[]. Net result: option card does not disappear from sidebar after sidebar-to-board drag.
all_findings.recommendation: Remove the setEditorTripData cross-slot options[] copy block from applyBridge. Board selection display is driven by editorSelections[targetKey]=optionId (already set at line 2874) — not by options[] membership. The option stays in originSlotId.options[] for sidebar display; the removal block then correctly removes it. Same-slot guard (originSlotId === targetSlotId) must be preserved.

all_findings.issue: AC4 FAIL: recomputeBudget writes updated budget to editorTripData.days[n].budget via setEditorTripData but budget display reads effectiveDay.budget. effectiveDay is computed by mergeEditorSelectionsIntoPublishedDay which deep-clones publishedDay (line 2040) and never propagates editorDay.budget into the result. Budget display always shows static publishedDay.budget.
all_findings.recommendation: Add budget propagation in mergeEditorSelectionsIntoPublishedDay after publishedDay clone: if (editorDay && editorDay.budget) { day.budget = Object.assign({}, day.budget, editorDay.budget); }. editorDay here is editorTripData.days[n], so editorDay.budget is exactly what recomputeBudget writes.

spec_section_updates.section_6:
Cycle 1 Why Not Met:
- AC3: applyBridge AC3 fix (remove from originSlotId.options[]) is structurally defeated. The immediately-preceding cross-meal copy block adds the option to targetSlotId.options[]. mealsGroup iterates ALL meal slots and deduplicates by option_id — it finds the option via targetSlotId and renders it in sidebar. Removal from origin is correct but insufficient while the option also exists in target.
- AC4: recomputeBudget writes to editorTripData.days[n].budget via setEditorTripData. Budget display reads day.budget where day = effectiveDay = mergeEditorSelectionsIntoPublishedDay(publishedDay, ...). mergeEditorSelectionsIntoPublishedDay deep-clones publishedDay (line 2040) and never reads editorDay.budget. The write destination and the read source are two different state objects that are never reconciled.
spec_section_updates.section_7:
Cycle 1 What Must Be Done:
- AC3 fix: In applyBridge, remove the setEditorTripData cross-slot copy block (lines ~2927-2945 that adds option to targetSlotId.options[]). Board card selection is driven by editorSelections state (set at line 2874), not by options[] membership. After removing the copy block, the existing removal block correctly removes the option from originSlotId.options[] and sidebar stops showing it.
- AC4 fix: In mergeEditorSelectionsIntoPublishedDay (~line 2040), after the JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(publishedDay)) clone, add: if (editorDay && editorDay.budget) { day.budget = Object.assign({}, day.budget, editorDay.budget); }. editorDay is editorTripData.days[n] passed into the function, so editorDay.budget is exactly what recomputeBudget writes via setEditorTripData.

summary.note: R1 had 2 critical issues (AC3, AC4 failures) — both resolved in R2. See r2_verification for full evidence.

AC1.evidence: browser_evaluate returned { sidebar_after: ['breakfast:board-default'], breakfast_board_default_appeared: true }. Sidebar count 0→1 for breakfast:board-default after board-to-sidebar drag event.

AC2.evidence: synthesized card rendered with option_id='breakfast:board-default', originSlotId='breakfast', label='🍽️ 餐厅', name='机场早餐/飞机餐', cost='5 CNY', draggable=true. Correct v2 shape.

AC3.evidence: browser_evaluate returned { sidebarMealCardsAfter: [], count: 0, dinner_1_1_in_sidebar: false } after window.applyEditorSelection('dinner-1-1', 'dinner', 'lunch'). Card absent from sidebar on next render.
AC3.r2_fix_verified: True move semantics in applyBridge and bridge: capture srcOpt from originSlot.options[], push to targetSlot.options[] if absent, filter from originSlot.options[]. isSelected guard at line 2502 (if (isSelected) return null) provides belt-and-suspenders defense. Both fixes confirmed in deployed HTML at /var/www/travel/beijing-lijiang-dali/2026-04-18/index.html.
AC3.same_slot_guard: window.applyEditorSelection with originSlotId===targetSlotId: structural guard (originSlotId !== slotId) skips removal block. Card disappears from sidebar due to isMealSelected returning true (option now selected) — correct behavior for a selected/on-board card.

AC4.evidence: Dynamic test: switching accommodation selection from accommodation-1-2 (580 CNY) to accommodation-1-1 (680 CNY) updated budget display from [Meals:€33, Accommodation:€580, Total:€613] to [Meals:€88, Accommodation:€680, Total:€768] within 2 seconds.
AC4.r2_fix_verified: Two-part fix: (1) mergeEditorSelectionsIntoPublishedDay adds Object.assign({}, day.budget, editorDay.budget) at line 2041-2043 — effectiveDay.budget now reflects editorDay.budget. (2) recomputeBudget maps entry.breakdown keys to editorTripData.days[n].budget with correct key mapping (breakdown.activities→budget.attractions) and Number() type cast. Both confirmed in deployed HTML.

AC5.evidence: Source verification: budgetSeqRef guard at line 2730 covers setLiveDayTotal; second guard at line 2741 covers the new setEditorTripData budget merge call. Both inside same .then() callback. Structurally correct.
AC5.note: Behavioral test of stale-seq race not separately triggered. Source-level verification sufficient per R1 baseline.

AC6.evidence: browser_evaluate returned { ac6_pass: true, bad_labels_found: [] }. No 'dinner'/'lunch'/'breakfast' labels found in sidebar meal cards. '🍽️ 餐厅' label confirmed in Local mode.

AC22.evidence: browser_evaluate returned { ac22_pass: true, badge_element_count: 0, status_badge_count: 0 }.

findings_classification.summary: AC3 BLOCKER — applyBridge doesn't preserve option in target slot options[]
findings_classification.rationale: R2 already implements exactly this fix. Source at lines 2926-2956 confirms true move semantics: srcOpt captured, pushed to tgtSlot.options[], filtered from srcSlot.options[]. Codex was working from the R1 code description in its prompt — this gap was the R1 failure, addressed in R2.

findings_classification.summary: AC3 BLOCKER — bridge() sets both target and origin to same optionId when _isCompatible
findings_classification.rationale: The _isCompatible dual-slot selection (line 2895) is a pre-existing design choice (M17b cross-meal showing). AC3 is scoped to 'card absent from sidebar' — not to board slot selection semantics. The isSelected guard definitively hides the card from sidebar regardless of _isCompatible behavior. Not an AC3 failure.

findings_classification.summary: AC3 GAP — selected-card hiding is meal-only; accommodation and activity candidates still copy
findings_classification.rationale: AC3 spec explicitly says 'meal candidate' and 'board meal slot.' Non-meal candidates are out of scope for this cycle.

findings_classification.summary: AC4 THREAT — intra_city API budget discarded, transportation row can go stale
findings_classification.rationale: The spec technical hints explicitly say 'breakdown.intra_city has no direct UI counterpart — either fold its amount into budget.transportation or discard'. Dev chose discard and documented it with a comment. Spec-sanctioned choice.

findings_classification.summary: AC4 THREAT — strict day comparison (===) can silently skip API budget entry
findings_classification.rationale: R2 already fixes this. Source at line 2731 shows Number(d.day) === Number(dayNum). Codex was working from R1 state description.
